CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

3. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Kings David and Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Kings David and Solomon has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kings David and Solomon.
   D. Use Kings David and Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers.
   B. Say Healing the 10 Lepers has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Healing the 10 Lepers to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Raising the Widow’s Son? (1 mark)
   A. Use Raising the Widow’s Son to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Raising the Widow’s Son.
   C. Say Raising the Widow’s Son has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Raising the Widow’s Son with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work: God Worked to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.
   D. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

9. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T.
   C. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.
   B. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Parable on prayer Midnight? (1 mark)
   A. Use Parable on prayer Midnight to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Parable on prayer Midnight with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Parable on prayer Midnight.
   D. Say Parable on prayer Midnight has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Leisure 8 5.4 Wealth Money and Poverty 8 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The s and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Leisure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Wealth, Money and Poverty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Work: God Worked and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
